name: Jailer Vifil

related.relation: his queen, whose every named enemy he keeps

facts.text: Jailer Vifil is a level-82 hrimthursa with 100,000 health who calls two hrimathursa tormentors from his tunnels.
He sends a player to a fixed spot in the tunnels away from the fight, as if to a cell.
Bot chat has a rumour that he holds one of the Troll Fathers in a cell, and says he keeps a cell for every enemy the queen has named.
Vifil (Vifill) is an Old Norse personal name (to verify).

story:
Vifil keeps the south tunnels and the cells cut into them. He was given the keys on the day the citadel was finished, and he has never put them down. There is a cell, they say, for every enemy Queen Kula has ever named, and most of them are full: dwarves who came to spy, svartalfar who came to trade and stayed, morvalt by the dozen, a few men of Jordheim who came up the crater road too early. The hrimathursa tormentors walk the tunnels between the cells, and Vifil walks behind them, counting.

At the end of the last row there is a cell set apart, with a door cut twice the height of the others and wider than any giant needs. Vifil visits it every morning. Nobody else is allowed down that far. No sound comes from it. The rumour in Midgard, which has outlived every raid that tried to check, is that he keeps a Troll Father in it: one of the ancient ones who went deeper when Trollheim fell, caught by the giants on some road under the island and brought to Kula as a prize. Vifil has never denied it. He has never said anything at all about his prisoners, which is why the rumour lives.

He does not trouble to fight everyone who comes. When you reach his tunnels he calls two tormentors to his side, and then he takes one of you by the collar and puts you somewhere else: deep in the tunnels, far from the fight, in the dark by the cells where the tormentors walk. Then he turns back to the rest. He does it again, and again, a jailer sorting prisoners, and a raid that does not run back to the fight quickly finds itself in pieces all over the south tunnels.

When he dies, he asks someone to take the keys. He does not say what they should do with them. The cells stand open after. The last one does not.
legend: When Vifil ports you, you land in the tunnels alone. Don't fight the tormentors there, run back to the raid. Keep someone ready to rez the ones he sends away, and keep the tormentors tanked. Don't drag him past his tether or he resets. And no, nobody has found the Troll Father. Yet. Some raiders swear they heard knocking from the last door. Nobody has opened it. He ports one person at a time, so the raid always has most of its strength; it's the slow drain of people stuck in the tunnels that kills you. Call out when you're ported, and the rezzer comes.

aggro: Another for the cells. There is always room.
Names. I need your names, for the ledger.

phases.text: You. Down the tunnel. Wait there.
Row three has room. Row three, then.

loremasterTopic.text: The queen's jailer, with a cell for every enemy she has named. He takes one of you by the collar and puts you deep in his tunnels. Some say a Troll Father sits in one of his cells. He has never said otherwise.

bookPage: Inventory of the south cells, as I was told it by a kobold who escaped them, which I do not believe and write down anyway. Twelve cells of the first row: dwarves. Nine of the second: Svartalfar who came to trade and stayed. Three of the third: men of Jordheim. One at the end, set apart, with a door twice the height of the others, which the jailer visits every morning and from which no sound ever comes. The kobold swore the door was cut for something wider than a giant. Then he asked for more ale.
